mapper.select: SELECT ud.id, ud.amount, ud.feedback, ud.feedback_img, ud.create_time, u.id as user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, p.id as project_id, p.category, p.name, p.description, p.image FROM user_donations ud LEFT JOIN user u ON ud.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON ud.project_id = p.id WHERE ud.id = #{id}
